messages:
maria_docs: quick sync — i'm updating the retention & legal-hold section in the compliance docs (PR #4123). i'd like to add a short, plain-language sentence about legal holds and a tiny SDK snippet showing how customers can mark audit logs as 'on hold' for e-discovery. @lee_security @jonathan_legal any quick objections?

lee_security: +1 to plain-language. two notes: (1) use the word 'preserve' instead of 'lock' — 'lock' suggests immutable storage; (2) call out KMS key usage for held logs.

jonathan_legal: legal is fine with 'legal hold' as the term, but we need a one-line clarification: 'We retain logs under legal hold until the hold is lifted by authorized personnel or a court order is closed.' keeps it clear and non-technical.

sam_eng: I can sketch the SDK snippets. should we include both JS and Python? my suggestion: keep them copy-pasteable and show the minimal auth header + payload. e.g.:

```python
# python example (requests)
resp = requests.post(
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs/hold",
  headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $API_KEY"},
  json={"log_id": "abc123", "hold": True, "reason": "litigation"}
)
```

```js
// node example
await fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs/hold", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ log_id: "abc123", hold: true, reason: "litigation" })
});
```

alex_devex: keep snippet minimal + add link to auth/roles. also call out the role permission name (e.g., `audit:hold`) so customers know required RBAC. avoid showing internal-only headers.

maria_docs: draft below (putting the plain-language sentence + snippet into the PR). also added a short compliance note about KMS and TTL interaction. draft: 

"Plain language: When a legal hold is issued, we preserve the relevant audit logs until the hold is lifted by authorized personnel. This preservation temporarily overrides standard retention TTLs for the affected logs."

SDK snippet (minimal):
```python
# Preserve an audit log entry (python)
import requests
resp = requests.post(
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs/hold",
  headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"},
  json={"log_id": "abc123", "hold": True, "reason": "legal hold - case 2025-09"}
)
print(resp.status_code)
```

Notes: requires `audit:hold` permission. Held logs are encrypted using the customer's KMS when configured; held logs bypass standard TTL-based deletion until the hold is removed.

lee_security: one small tweak — prefer the header example to use `Authorization: Bearer TOKEN` in the snippet and add a parenthetical about KMS: "(when customer KMS is configured, held logs are encrypted with the customer key)". also explicitly state: "TTL-based purges are paused for held items."

jonathan_legal: LGTM after those tweaks. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR 4123 updated — branch 'docs/legal-hold-snippet' pushed; CI: ✓ build passed, linkcheck: ✓

maria_docs: thanks all — i'll apply lee's header tweak and merge once CI completes. i also added a reference link to the SOC2 audit-logs appendix: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2#audit-logs (doc internal link).
